dialog.english:
It's so nice to be on solid
ground!
dialog.translation:
¡Qué bien se está en tierra
firme!

dialog.english:
I didn't think it'd *actually*
take five days.
dialog.translation:
No pensé que tardaría
cinco días.

dialog.english:
It wouldn't have been unusual for
it to have taken longer.
dialog.translation:
No habría sido raro que
tardara más.

dialog.english:
Yep, yep, it's all thanks to
Whamon!
This is a really big island.

It's not an island, it's a
continent!
dialog.translation:
¡No es una isla, es un
continente!

dialog.english: First time bein' on so much land.
dialog.translation: Primera vez que veo tanta tierra.

Así que este es el Continente
Server...

dialog.english: So, where do we go now?

Whamon said there's a Koromon
village in the forest.
dialog.translation:
Whamon dijo que hay una aldea
Koromon en el bosque.

dialog.english: I used to be a Koromon.

The Koromon should be willing to
help us.

A Koromon village in the middle of
the forest? Lemme take a quick
look.
dialog.translation:
¿Una aldea Koromon en medio
del bosque? Voy a echar un
vistazo.

dialog.english:
There's a huge gap in the middle
of the forest. I bet that's the
village.
dialog.translation:
Hay un claro enorme en medio
del bosque. Seguro que es la
aldea.

dialog.english:
Well then, that seems to settle
it.
A bath, a bath, a bath!

She's always off in her own
world...

There aren't any Koromon here,
just a bunch of Pagumon...
dialog.translation:
Aquí no hay Koromon,
solo un montón de Pagumon...

dialog.english:
They definitely don't look like
Koromon.
dialog.translation:
Está claro que no parecen
Koromon.

dialog.english:
Well, we'll just have to talk to
them for now!
dialog.translation:
¡Bueno, por ahora tendremos
que hablar con ellos!

dialog.english:
Hey, I heard there's a Koromon
village around here, but...
dialog.translation:
Oye, dijeron que había una
aldea Koromon por aquí, pero...

dialog.english: So it really is a Pagumon village.
dialog.translation: Entonces sí es una aldea Pagumon.

dialog.english: Hey, is he calling me an insect?

Pagumon are said to be nasty
Digimon.
dialog.translation:
Dicen que los Pagumon son
Digimon malos.

dialog.english:
It's a joke! We're giving you a
warm welcome here!

Are there only Pagumon in this
village? Like, say, are there any
Koromon...?
dialog.translation:
¿Solo hay Pagumon en esta
aldea? O sea, ¿hay algún
Koromon...?

dialog.english:
Koromon? I've never seen any
Digimon called Koromon!
dialog.translation:
¿Koromon? ¡Nunca he visto un
Digimon llamado Koromon!

dialog.english:
You've never seen a Koromon, not
even once?
dialog.translation:
¿Nunca has visto un Koromon,
ni una sola vez?

dialog.english: We came here from File Island...

File Island? More importantly,
look how cute we are!
dialog.translation:
¿Isla File? ¡Mejor mirad qué
majos que somos!

dialog.english: Sorry! I didn't mean it like that.

Heh heh heh! I'm kidding, I'm
kidding!

We're searching for the Koromon
village, but...

Wah! I've never seen this Digimon
before!

Oh, no. I'm not a Digimon, I'm a
human.
dialog.translation:
No, no. No soy un Digimon,
soy humano.

dialog.english:
A hu-man? I've never heard of that
kind of Digimon!
dialog.translation:
¿Un hu-mano? ¡Nunca he oído de ese
tipo de Digimon!

dialog.english: Hey, do you know of any Koromon?

Ah! Tai! It doesn't look like
there are any Koromon here.
dialog.translation:
¡Ah! ¡Tai! No parece que haya
Koromon por aquí.

dialog.english:
Yeah, no matter where you go,
there's just Pagumon.
dialog.translation:
Sí, vayas donde vayas,
solo hay Pagumon.

dialog.english:
It's weird! I could have sworn I
smelled Koromon...
dialog.translation:
¡Qué raro! Juraría que olí
a Koromon...

dialog.english:
Maybe it used to be a Koromon
village, and the Koromon moved
away.
dialog.translation:
Quizás antes era una aldea
Koromon, y se mudaron.

dialog.english:
But it smells like they were here
recently.
dialog.translation:
Pero huele a que estuvieron
aquí hace poco.

dialog.english:
Thank you for coming, everyone!
We've prepared a feast for you!
dialog.translation:
¡Gracias a todos por venir!
¡Os preparamos un banquete!

dialog.english: Well, let's stay here for the day.

I felt like Otohime when she
arrived at the Dragon Palace!
dialog.translation:
¡Me sentí como Otohime
llegando al Palacio del Dragón!

dialog.english: T.K, let's do what we can!

Okay, we'll save all the
investigation for tomorrow.
dialog.translation:
Vale, dejamos la
investigación para mañana.

dialog.english:
T.K? Are you going to the
bathroom?
W-why are you doing this to me?

Were you fooled? Then you're
stupid!
He came with a bunch of humans!

They couldn't possibly be the
Chosen Children, can they?

I'm gonna report this to Lord
Etemon. I'll leave the rest to
you!
dialog.translation:
Voy a avisar al Señor
Etemon. ¡Os dejo el resto
a vosotros!

dialog.english:
Got it! All you Pagumon have to
keep an eye on the humans. Don't
let them escape!
dialog.translation:
¡Entendido! Pagumon, vigilad
a los humanos. ¡Que no
escapen!

dialog.english:
Tokomon's gone. We were sleeping
together, but...
dialog.translation:
Tokomon no está. Dormíamos
juntos, pero...

dialog.english:
Agumon! Do you know anything about
this?

I was sleeping so soundly, I
didn't even notice.
dialog.translation:
Dormía tan profundo que ni
me enteré.

dialog.english:
All right, let's get everyone else
to look for him!
dialog.translation:
¡Bien, que los demás
también le busquen!

dialog.english:
Hey, have you seen Tokomon
anywhere?

Tokomon? He went back by himself,
didn't he?
No, there's no way he would.

I don't know anything about
Tokomon!

Hey, you were there with us last
night! Poyomon evolved!

...Maybe he wasn't even there in
the first place?
I'm asking if Tokomon was here.

Doesn't seem like you know
anything about it.
dialog.translation:
No parece que sepáis
nada de esto.

dialog.english:
Don't tell me Agumon's
disappeared, too?
dialog.translation:
¡No me digas que Agumon
también ha desaparecido!

dialog.english:
I *knew* there was something weird
about this village!
dialog.translation:
¡Sabía que esta aldea tenía
algo raro!

dialog.english:
Guys! There's smoke coming from
over there!

We need to offer the Chosen
Children to Lord Etemon!
dialog.translation:
¡Debemos ofrecer a los Niños
Elegidos al Señor Etemon!

dialog.english: Give it up! You're done for!

Yeah! I got captured by the
Pagumon and Gazimon, and Agumon
came to save me!
dialog.translation:
¡Sí! ¡Me capturaron los
Pagumon y Gazimon, y Agumon
vino a salvarme!

dialog.english: How'd you know we were here?

I secretly set off smoke signals
by using Baby Flame on some dead
trees!
dialog.translation:
¡Hice señales de humo a
escondidas con Llama Bebé
en unos árboles secos!

dialog.english:
Perfect! The Chosen Children have
gathered together! Now we have
them right where we want them!
dialog.translation:
¡Perfecto! ¡Los Niños Elegidos
se han reunido! ¡Ahora los
tenemos donde queríamos!

dialog.english:
T.K, I'm sorry for making you
worry...

Don't worry, I'm just glad you're
safe!
dialog.translation:
¡Tranquilo, me alegra que
estés a salvo!

dialog.english:
I can smell Koromon from the back
of the cave. I bet the Pagumon
captured them!
dialog.translation:
Huelo a Koromon al fondo
de la cueva. ¡Seguro que los
Pagumon los capturaron!

dialog.english: Then we have to save the Koromon!

You got rid of the Pagumon!
We're saved!

Did you break out on your own?
Where are the Pagumon?

They ran away and forgot the key
to our prison!
dialog.translation:
¡Huyeron y se olvidaron la
llave de la prisión!

dialog.english:
A few days ago, the Pagumon came
and took over our village.
dialog.translation:
Hace unos días, los Pagumon
vinieron y tomaron nuestra
aldea.

dialog.english:
So it really *was* a Koromon
village!

Then what were those Digimon from
before?
dialog.translation:
¿Entonces qué eran esos
Digimon de antes?

dialog.english:
Those Gazimon were saying that
they wanted to take you guys to
Etemon!
dialog.translation:
¡Esos Gazimon decían que
os querían llevar ante
Etemon!

dialog.english: Chosen Children! Can you hear me?

Sounds like it's coming from
outside!

What's that? There's a huge
Digimon in the sky!
dialog.translation:
¿Qué es eso? ¡Hay un Digimon
enorme en el cielo!

dialog.english:
No, that's not the Digimon
himself, it's a hologram! It's
just a three-dimensional image!
dialog.translation:
¡No, ese no es el Digimon
de verdad, es un holograma!
¡Solo una imagen en 3D!

dialog.english:
You did well in bringing them
here, my beloved Gazimon.
dialog.translation:
Bien hecho trayéndolos
aquí, mis queridos Gazimon.
Es el jefe de los Gazimon...

dialog.english:
I'll make the whole village you're
standing in disappear!
dialog.translation:
¡Haré desaparecer toda la
aldea en la que estáis!

dialog.english:
He couldn't do something like
that...
Guys! We have to stop him!
I won't let you! Love Serenade!

That song just right sucked out
all my fightin' power.
dialog.translation:
Esa canción me chupó toda
la energía de un tirón.

dialog.english:
It doesn't matter what attacks we
use, he's a powerful and
formidable opponent!
dialog.translation:
¡Da igual qué ataque
usemos, es un rival poderoso
y temible!

dialog.english:
We can't do nothin' at this rate,
we have to evolve further!
dialog.translation:
¡Así no llegamos a nada,
tenemos que evolucionar más!

dialog.english:
So that's why Gennai said that we
need to get the Tags and Crests!
dialog.translation:
¡Por eso Gennai dijo que
necesitamos los Circuitos
y Emblemas!

dialog.english:
What do we do? Etemon's outside,
he's waiting for us.

If you follow this to the end, you
can escape!
dialog.translation:
¡Si seguís esto hasta el
final, podréis escapar!

dialog.english:
Legend says that we can escape
through here if anything happens!
dialog.translation:
¡La leyenda dice que se
puede escapar por aquí si
pasa algo!

dialog.english:
Just like a Koromon, pulling off
something so awesome!
dialog.translation:
¡Muy propio de un Koromon,
hacer algo tan genial!

dialog.english:
You ain't even a Koromon
anymore...
dialog.translation:
Si ya ni siquiera eres un
Koromon...

dialog.english:
There's something drawn on the
wall.
dialog.translation:
Hay algo dibujado en
la pared.

dialog.english:
We're at a mountain really,
reeeeeeeeeeeally far from our
village.
dialog.translation:
Estamos en una montaña
realmente reeealmente lejos
de nuestra aldea.

dialog.english:
That symbol in the cave must have
had a warp function...
dialog.translation:
Ese símbolo de la cueva
debía teletransportar...

dialog.english:
A Crest. I got a Crest! Now
Etemon's nothing to fear!
dialog.translation:
Un Emblema. ¡Tengo un
Emblema! ¡Ya no temo a
Etemon!

dialog.english: Why can't we come this way?

Uhhhhh, because I said so! You
can't!

Okay, okay.
We won't go this way.
dialog.translation:
Vale, vale.
No iremos por ahí.

dialog.english:
Tai! Where are you going?
We still haven't found Tokomon!
dialog.translation:
¡Tai! ¿A dónde vas? ¡Aún no
hemos encontrado a Tokomon!

dialog.english:
I thought he might be outside the
village.
dialog.translation:
Pensé que podría estar
fuera de la aldea.

dialog.english:
You might be right, but we should
look here for a bit longer!
dialog.translation:
¡Puede que tengas razón,
pero busquemos aquí un poco
más!

dialog.english:
Got it. I'll search this place
more thoroughly.
dialog.translation:
Entendido. Buscaré aquí
con más cuidado.

dialog.english:
Stop! It's dangerous beyond here!
This area is off limits!
dialog.translation:
¡Alto! ¡Es peligroso más
allá! ¡Esta zona está
prohibida!

dialog.english:
Huh? Really? We can't even take a
little peek?
